title: Shulker export override folders
description: Where each override file a shulker export ships came from in the project, kept in shulker.overrides.json at the root of the archive beside shulker.json and shulker.lock. A feature's files ship in overrides/ like any other, and an import reads this to put them back in the feature's folder. Shulker writes this file.

$schema.description: The version of this file, as a published schema URL.

folders.description: The project folder each override came from, by its path in the archive, such as "overrides/config/iris.properties": "shaders-overrides". Only files from a folder other than the one they ship in are listed.
